summary: The Big Data Analytics Engineer develops scalable data pipelines and platforms to support large-scale analytics, dashboards, and machine learning initiatives.
responsibilities: Build and optimize big data pipelines for analytics workloads
Design and implement data models for large-scale datasets
Support data extraction, transformation, and visualization for BI
Collaborate with data scientists for ML feature engineering
Ensure data quality, governance, and performance tuning

education: 3–6 years of experience in big data analytics engineering

skills_required.name: Expertise in SQL, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud analytics tools
Strong Python or Scala programming skills
Knowledge of ETL/ELT and data modeling best practices
Experience with data lakes and warehouses
